intentEvidence: Bring your Obsidian notes and attachments straight into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
motivation: Tired of manually copying and pasting your notes (and hunting down attachments) every time you want to ask AI a question?
problem: Users are tired of manually copying and pasting notes and searching for attachments when querying AI.

relations.evidence: When paired with the NoteFerry browser extension, it lets you directly select and pull your Obsidian notes

summary: A local bridge that allows users to select and attach Obsidian notes and attachments directly into AI chat interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
